About Aida

The founder behind the peak

Aida founded Owj Real Estate in Business Bay with one promise — the one in her own bio: at the peak, you experience the smartest and most secure investment. On camera and in person, she walks clients through Dubai's finest homes herself, from Palm Jumeirah villas to skyline residences, and leads a full-service brokerage covering off-plan launches, secondary sales and rentals.

How Buying Works

From first call to the peak, in four steps

01

Strategy

A direct conversation with Aida's team: budget, goal, timeline — and an honest read of the market.

02

Selection

A shortlist of Dubai's finest fits — off-plan launches or ready homes — with private viewings arranged.

03

Negotiation

Owj negotiates on your side and handles the paperwork — terms, contracts and compliance, in order.

04

Closing

Transfer, handover and keys — and a team that stays with you after the deal, for renting or reselling.
